title: The remediation report says fixed, the scanner says vulnerable
scenario: claimdesk-web 7.5.0 passed Corvane's SBOM-based release gate with 0 open CRITICAL findings and is in production. This morning's image scan shows two CRITICAL findings. A developer blames the scanner's newer database; AppSec needs to know which tool is right before an emergency patch.
task: Settle each disagreement between the gate and the scanner with versions, ranges and code
Rule the scanner-database theory in or out
Fix remediate.py with Maven version semantics and add tests
Re-run the gate and state what 7.5.0 really ships
acceptance: Version ordering handles multi-digit segments, trailing zeros and qualifiers; multi-range advisories
Correct status for every advisory on the provided SBOMs; the gate fails 7.5.0
ANSWER.md explains the string comparison with evidence and the AppSec follow-up
